title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: Master Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Bright soundboard captures a tight, high‑energy 1982 second set with a ripping China Cat > Rider into Samson & Delilah and a soaring Iko Iko.
ai_review.review: The recording is a crystal‑clear soundboard mix that highlights the bright tonality of the 1982 show, especially the punchy drum work. The performance is described as one of the tightest ever, with a high‑energy second set packed with standout moments like China Cat → Rider, Samson & Delilah, High Time, Iko Iko and a haunting Black Peter/Bertha close.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviewers praise both the musical performance (tight, high‑energy set) and the recording quality (bright, clear soundboard); weighted average yields a near‑excellent rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bright, clear mix with especially good drum definition; no significant flaws mentioned.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set packed with goodies before Drumz/Space, smooth transitions and sustained high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: High‑energy playing throughout the second set; keeps the band tight.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum sound bright and punchy, well‑balanced and a highlight of the mix.
